Class ScatterPlotAnalysisCase

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.occurrences.SysMLOccurrence
sysmlinjava.actions.SysMLAction
sysmlinjava.actions.SysMLCalculation
sysmlinjava.actions.SysMLCase
sysmlinjava.analysis.SysMLAnalysisCase
sysmlinjava.analysis.ParametricAnalysisCase
sysmlinjava.views.scatterplots.ScatterPlotAnalysisCase
All Implemented Interfaces:
AttributeObserver, ObservableAttribute, StateBehaviorContext
public abstract class ScatterPlotAnalysisCase extends ParametricAnalysisCase
ScatterPlotsConstraintBlock is a SysMLinJava model of a constraint block that produces a scatter plot chart representation of the a sequence of X-Y values which are the sequence of values of the constraint parameters over time, i.e. the constraint produces the scatter plot from the constraint parameter values.

    • ScatterPlotAnalysisCase

      public ScatterPlotAnalysisCase(ScatterPlotDefinition plotDefinition, int udpPort, boolean logToConsole)
      Constructor - initialization
      Parameters:
      plotDefinition - definition of the plot display
      udpPort - UDP port to which the plot definition and data are to be sent
      logToConsole - whether to send all transmit() logs to console. Note: transmit() operation can log every object's toString() string to the console. The more frequently log messages are sent to console, the greater the CPU resources are needed. This can cause noticable slowing of the console display and related applications.

    • createParameters

      protected void createParameters()
      Description copied from class: ParametricAnalysisCase
      Overridable abstract operation that should create the analysis's parameters initializing them and the "put"-ing the initialized instances of each into the params map with their appropriate "key"s, i.e. their parameter IDs. An example follows: 
      
 		:
	&#64;Override
	protected void createParameters()
	{
		params = KeyValueMap.of(
			List.of("paramA", "paramB", "paramC"),
			List.of(new FirstParamType(), new NextParamType(), new LastParamType()));
	}
      Note each parameter must be a type of SysMLAttributeType as the SysMLAttributeType provides the features needed for binding of analysis parameters to attributes.
      Overrides:
      createParameters in class ParametricAnalysisCase
      See Also:
      • SysMLAttributeType
